__doc: Fees collected and reward tokens distributed, for the dashboard's first two
cards. No explorer knows these — they are protocol figures — so this file is
the simplest way to feed them: same-origin, no CORS, no infrastructure.
THESE ARE HAND-ENTERED, read off $BOX's Stockify panel on 2026-09-04:
paid to holders  $59   / 0.2307 AMZNc   (90% to holders, 10% protocol)
They reconcile: fees x 0.9 = 0.2680 = paid 0.2307 + waiting 0.0373.
They are a SNAPSHOT and go stale. scripts/index-rewards.mjs overwrites this
whole file with scanned figures once it has run a full backfill; until then
these stand in. holders stays null on purpose — the panel does not publish
a holder count, and only the scan can produce one.
